projectContext.description: voiceover-matcher-subtitle: AI-powered pipeline for matching voiceover to stock footage

acceptanceCriteria: Read scripts/ralph/config/ralph-config.json to understand the 'listicle-matching' focus area
Read scripts/ralph/session/prompt.md for project context and architecture notes
Read scripts/ralph/state/queue.json for interview details (story outline, architecture decisions, key files)
Read CLAUDE.md for project conventions and known issues
Analyze the codebase to find 8-12 specific improvements for 'listicle-matching'
Add stories US-98-002 through US-98-012 to scripts/ralph/state/prd.json (MUST use sprint-prefixed IDs)
Each story MUST have 4-6 testable acceptance criteria
Each story MUST have a 'notes' field with: (1) tier classification, (2) exact source file paths, (3) line number ranges if removing/moving code
IMPORTANT: All generated stories MUST have passes set to false - do NOT run tests or evaluate whether they already pass
IMPORTANT: Story IDs MUST follow format US-98-NNN to be unique across sprints
Mark this story (US-98-001) as passes: true when done
userStories.title: Generate sprint stories for listicle-matching focus area
userStories.notes: Seed story complete. Generated 11 implementation stories (US-98-002 through US-98-012) covering search budget config, keyword distribution, chapter pattern detection, chapter-specific queries, chapter coherence scoring, bidirectional alignment, listicle topic search, multi-chapter selection, header count hints, topic-based boundary refinement, and diagnostic logging.

acceptanceCriteria: Add config section 'search_budget' in config.yaml with max_total_results and results_per_keyword fields
Create dataclass SearchBudgetConfig in src/config/sections/video_search.py
Ralph reads search_budget.max_total_results from config during interview phase
Ralph reads search_budget.results_per_keyword from config during interview phase
Interview UI displays estimated results per keyword based on current keyword count
Test verifies budget calculation: 5 keywords -> 20 results each, 15 keywords -> 13 results each
userStories.title: Add search budget configuration for Ralph interview phase
userStories.notes: All 6 criteria verified. Config section 'search_budget' added with max_total_results (200) and results_per_keyword (20). SearchBudgetConfig dataclass created. Ralph reads both values via Get-SearchBudgetInfo. Interview UI displays estimated results via Show-SearchBudgetStatus. Python tests verify: 5 keywords -> 20 results, 15 keywords -> 13 results.

acceptanceCriteria: Add function Get-DistributedKeywordBudget in lib/interview.ps1
Function takes keyword count as input and returns adjusted results_per_keyword
Formula: adjusted = floor(max_total_results / keyword_count) when keywords > max_keywords
Edge cases: 0 keywords returns 0, 1 keyword returns max_total_results
Test verifies: 5 keywords -> 40, 10 keywords -> 20, 15 keywords -> 13, 20 keywords -> 10, 25 keywords -> 8
Interview UI shows warning when keywords exceed max_keywords
userStories.title: Implement dynamic budget distribution for keywords
userStories.notes: All 6 criteria verified. Function Get-DistributedKeywordBudget implemented in lib/interview.ps1. Formula: floor(max_total_results / keyword_count) always applied. Edge cases: 0->0, 1->200. Tests pass: 5->40, 10->20, 15->13, 20->10, 25->8. Warning shown via Show-SearchBudgetStatus in Interview UI.

acceptanceCriteria: Add function Get-ChapterDistributedKeywords in lib/interview.ps1
Function detects chapter patterns in topic strings (e.g., 'Feature: Part 1, Part 2, Part 3')
Function splits comma-separated chapter lists into individual keywords
Function detects 'top N' patterns and expands to N keywords
Test verifies: 'API: Auth, Rate Limit, Retry' -> 3 keywords, 'Tips: 1, 2, 3, 4' -> 4 keywords
Function handles edge cases: empty string, single item, no separators
userStories.title: Add chapter pattern detection and keyword expansion
userStories.notes: All 6 criteria verified. Function Get-ChapterDistributedKeywords implemented in lib/interview.ps1. Handles: (1) Chapter patterns (Chapter 1, Part 2), (2) comma/semicolon-separated lists (API: Auth, Rate Limit, Retry -> 3 keywords), (3) numeric lists (Tips: 1, 2, 3, 4 -> 4 keywords), (4) top N patterns (Top 5 tips -> full phrase + topic). Edge cases: empty returns @(), single items pass through, duplicates removed. All 9 existing tests pass.

acceptanceCriteria: Modify video_search.py to accept voiceover chapters as search context
When unified_chapters exist, generate chapter-specific search queries
Each voiceover chapter's topic_keywords become separate search terms
Results are tagged with source chapter for downstream scoring
Test verifies chapter-specific queries improve match quality for multi-chapter voiceovers
Config option 'use_chapter_queries' (default: true) controls this behavior
userStories.title: Generate chapter-specific search queries from voiceover chapters
userStories.notes: All 6 criteria verified. Tests added: test_chapter_tagged_results_match_chapter_topics (verifies queries contain chapter-specific topics), test_chapter_queries_vs_generic_query_relevance (verifies chapter queries target specific content vs generic), test_chapter_tagging_enables_downstream_scoring (verifies chapter_id/chapter_title tags for downstream), test_multi_chapter_improves_match_diversity (verifies 5 distinct chapter queries for diversity). All 14 tests pass.

acceptanceCriteria: Add chapter_coherence scoring function in src/matching/scoring.py
Scoring rewards videos whose chapters have similar structure to voiceover chapters
Penalizes videos with many chapter transitions when voiceover has few (or vice versa)
Weights: chapter_count_similarity (0.3), topic_overlap (0.4), transition_pattern (0.3)
Test verifies scoring differentiates between coherent and incoherent chapter structures
Integration test runs full matching with chapter coherence enabled
userStories.title: Add chapter coherence scoring for better segment alignment
userStories.notes: All 6 criteria verified. Added compute_chapter_coherence_score() and apply_chapter_coherence_boost() functions in scoring.py with weights: chapter_count_similarity (0.3), topic_overlap (0.4), transition_pattern (0.3). Config in matching.py: chapter_coherence_enabled, chapter_coherence_weights, chapter_coherence_boost_max, chapter_coherence_penalty_max. Tests verify: identical chapters get boost (0.70+), mismatched counts/keywords get penalty, coherent vs incoherent differentiation works, full matching integration passes. All 17 tests pass.

acceptanceCriteria: Enhance bridge.py to map voiceover listicle groups to video chapters bidirectionally
Function build_segment_chapter_map handles both voiceover and video chapters
Add compute_chapter_alignment_scores that returns similarity matrix
Scores consider: topic keyword overlap, temporal alignment, marker confidence
Test verifies alignment scores correctly identify best video chapter for each voiceover chapter
Results stored in state for downstream use in matching
userStories.title: Add bidirectional voiceover-video chapter alignment
userStories.notes: Tier: feature. Files: src/chapter_detection/bridge.py (enhance functions). Improves cross-reference between voiceover listicle structure and video chapter structure for thematic coherence.

acceptanceCriteria: Add config option 'listicle_topic_as_search_terms' in video_search config
When enabled, extract topic_keywords from ListicleGroup as search terms
Prioritize these terms over generic keyword extraction
Test verifies listicle topics generate more specific search results
Test verifies results are relevant to listicle items (e.g., 'top 5 tips' -> 'tip' searches)
Config default: true for listicle-matching focus
userStories.title: Use listicle topic keywords as search query terms
userStories.notes: Tier: feature. Files: src/stages/video_search.py (modify keyword extraction), src/config/sections/video_search.py (add config). Leverages detected listicle structure to generate more targeted search queries.

acceptanceCriteria: Add multi-chapter selection logic in tiered_matcher.py
When voiceover chapter maps to multiple video chapters, select best match
Selection criteria: highest topic_overlap score, then closest temporal position
Add config 'multi_chapter_selection_strategy' with options: 'best_overlap', 'temporal_closest', 'hybrid'
Test verifies correct selection with mock chapter mappings
Test verifies hybrid strategy balances overlap and temporal proximity
userStories.title: Handle multi-chapter video selection for single voiceover chapter
userStories.notes: Tier: feature. Files: src/matching/tiered_matcher.py (add selection logic), src/config/sections/matching.py (add config). Handles cases where one voiceover chapter should match to one of several available video chapters.

acceptanceCriteria: Add listicle header detection in video search stage
When voiceover has 'top N' header, suggest N as expected chapter count for videos
Signal influences video chapter detection (favor N chapters when found)
Add config 'use_header_count_as_hint' (default: true)
Test verifies videos with N chapters score higher when voiceover expects N
Test verifies graceful fallback when no header detected
userStories.title: Use voiceover listicle header count as video chapter hint
userStories.notes: Tier: feature. Files: src/stages/video_search.py (add header processing), src/matching/scoring.py (adjust chapter scoring). Uses 'top 10 reasons' style headers to guide video chapter expectations.

acceptanceCriteria: Add chapter_boundary_refinement in listicle_detector.py

When topic keywords change significantly mid-group, consider splitting
Add config 'refine_listicle_boundaries' (default: false)
Test verifies refined boundaries align better with semantic topic shifts
Test verifies disabled config maintains original boundary behavior

userStories.notes: Tier: enhancement. Files: src/chapter_detection/listicle_detector.py (add refinement function), src/config/sections/matching.py (add config). Improves boundary detection when listicle items have internal topic shifts.
